use_case: Room reveal, view reveal, weekend escape

timeline.label: Hook
timeline.visual: Wide landscape or ocean view through window. Curtains gently moving.
timeline.audio: Nature ambience. Gentle breeze. Soft pad enters.

timeline.label: Room
timeline.visual: Slow pan across the room. Bed, bathroom, deck.

timeline.label: Experience
timeline.visual: Coffee on deck. Pool view. Sunset. Guest smiling.

timeline.label: Offer
timeline.visual: Calendar graphic. Dates highlighted. Rate displayed.

sound_direction: Calm, expensive, escape. 85 BPM. Nature ambience + soft pads. Warm fade at CTA.
export_notes: 1080p, 9:16, H.264. Wide shots preferred. Natural lighting only. Logo clear in final frame.
client_usage: Replace visuals with your property. Replace text with your name and offer. Use your Brand Sound Pack.
